title: Madad karo fizza
body:
Madad karo fizza
Madad karo fizza
<<DIVIDER>>
Shikasta pehlu se mere ye dar hata do khudara
1) tumhari zehmaten jaldi se ab tamam karun, Mai jaate jaate jahan se unhe salam karun, Wo dekho aa gaye baba utha do deke sahara.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2
<<DIVIDER>>
2) gira hai toot k aangan me goshwara mera, Hai kaan zakhmi sitamgar ne is tarha maara, Ali na dekhen khudara chupa do zakhm ye mera.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2
<<DIVIDER>>
3) chalo madine me ik ik ghar pe jayenge, Ghadeer kya hai unhe Yaad hum dilayenge, Fidak to chin gaya mera ye haq na cheene Ali ka.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2
<<DIVIDER>>
4) mareez e maut ke jaisi za'eef lagti hun, Mai aaj tumse zyada za'eef lagti hun, Laga hai jabse tamacha mujhe nazar nahi aata.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2
<<DIVIDER>>
5) sahara de ke mujhe chalo khudara wahan, Wo rassi baandh ke haider ko le gaye hain jahan, Na ab ho der khudara hai mera mola akela.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Ye baat soch k dil se paara paara hai, Hasan k samne zalim ne mujhko maara hai, Bata do kaise karungi bhala mai saamna uska.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Mai baal khol k arsh e khuda hila dungi, Abul hasan ko na choda to bad dua dungi, Dua k waste mera ye haath utha do khudara.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Koi ye keh k takallum khamosh ho bibi, Mai apne laal se rukhsat na ho sakungi kabhi, Lita do janib e qibla hussain aata hi hoga.
<<MINI>>
Madad karo fizza-2.
